title: Roma 2443 — I’m releasing my game on Steam with this trailer.
author: VermicelleMeet

comments.author: Low-Spell1867
comments.body: Looks pretty cool, what did you use for the engine and assets? and how long did it take for you to get to this point if you don't mind me asking

replies.author: VermicelleMeet
replies.body:
Hi! I built this game using Phaser and the Tiny RTS asset pack by Pixel Frog.

For units that weren't included in the asset pack, such as the helicopter and the tank, I used AI-generated assets and carefully adapted them to match the original art style as closely as possible.

It took me around five months to reach this stage of development. The game currently features replay mode, spectator mode, ranked matchmaking, and several other gameplay systems.

replies.body:
This asset pack is amazing, and I've seen it used in many different projects. One example is Tiny RTS, which uses the same assets but takes a more classic approach to the RTS genre.

Could you share your project here? I'd love to take a look at it.
